# Bundled TeXcount

Unmodified TeXcount 3.1.1 (2018-10-28), copyright 2008–2018 Einar Andreas Rødland.

- Official package: https://ctan.org/pkg/texcount
- Downloaded script: https://tug.ctan.org/support/texcount/texcount.pl
- SHA-256: `563049292e565808e78df75703a966c0064b9a956cb07edb65236eee0007fb90`
- Upstream README is preserved as `UPSTREAM-README.md`.
- Distributed under the LaTeX Project Public License; the license text is included in `LICENSE.txt`.

Prism executes this script with the system Perl in a restricted macOS sandbox against an immutable copy of managed project text. It never invokes LaTeX or imported scripts for word counting. Source files and the report are not sent to a network service.
